narrative.details:
You've alraedy mastered taming a boar, now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.
narrative.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, Darlin! You're quite in tune with the beast.

mentionedItems.name: Taming Rod
tooltip: Use: Begins taming a Gray Forest Wolf to be your companion for 10 minutes. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.
